mainEntity.name: Why is my pace per mile a bigger number than my pace per km?

acceptedAnswer.text: A mile is about 1.61 km, so it takes longer to cover at the same speed. Your pace per mile is always about 1.61 times your pace per kilometre.

mainEntity.name: How accurate are race time predictions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Riegel's formula works well between similar distances for runners trained for both. The further apart the distances — for example predicting a marathon from a 5K — the more likely the prediction is too fast.

mainEntity.name: What's a good pace for a beginner?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's no single number. Most beginners do best running at a conversational pace — one where you can speak in full sentences — and let speed come with consistent training.
